testMappings.assertion: Forward, reverse, wraparound, and empty-list indices match the source vectors.

testMappings.upstream: wrapTextByWidth traverses wide graphemes once while honoring remaining line cells
testMappings.assertion: Every chunk text, width, and starts-new-line flag is asserted for all source clusters.

testMappings.assertion: All ASCII, CJK, emoji, ZWJ, partial-cluster, zero-width, and out-of-range UTF-16 bounds match.

testMappings.upstream: complex cluster widths stay exact across bounded-cache churn
testMappings.assertion: All 300 unique combining clusters plus the oversized cluster remain exact across eviction churn.

adaptations: Ratatui and Crossterm use UTF-8 Rust strings. The JavaScript lone-surrogate width vector has no valid Rust string representation and is rejected before these helpers; every valid scalar and grapheme vector remains exact.
Rust reports UTF-16 indices only at the Hunk-compatible selection boundary while retaining byte-safe UTF-8 internally.
Hunk's React memoization and OpenTUI layout calls are represented by immutable native plans and value-keyed caches; the asserted content, widths, rows, anchors, and bounds are unchanged.
